definitions.verified-additional-tape: A source-verified UTA cassette relationship safe to expose after matcher/curation qualification.
definitions.catalogue-metadata-correction: UTA evidence points to the intended game, but games.json identity/metadata must be repaired first.
definitions.different-c64-version: The UTA title candidate belongs to another C64 conversion, game, or release lineage and must not be attached.
definitions.genuinely-no-uta-release: No verified compatible UTA cassette directory remains for the exact catalogue record after the residual audit. This does not imply that no commercial cassette ever existed.
